cues: Skim: ninety seconds for the title, the first sentence of every paragraph and the last sentence of the passage.
Read the questions, all of them, before you read the passage properly, and underline the key word in each.
Scan and mark: hunt each key word in the passage, and write the question number in the margin.
Write, question by question, from the marked lines, with the passage open.
